summary: Transit Pro Tech Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that Senior Consultant David E. Staplin presented the company's "Intelligent Rail Fault Detection System" at the AREMA 2026 Annual Conference Expo in Kansas City, Missouri on September 14, 2026. Exhibit 99.1 contains the presentation slides, which are furnished and not deemed filed for Section 18 liability purposes. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is disclosed. This is a routine product and technology disclosure, not a special situation, with no deal terms or risk-arb angle.
